about: Ten tasks for agent_loop.py --metric. Each holds the replies a model gave, in order; --offline replays them, so the loop and its metric run with no model and no network. The first reply of each has one mistake the compiler names.

tasks.task: Print the sum of the whole numbers from 1 to 10.
Read the text "42" as a whole number and print one more than it, saying why if the text is not a number.
Write a function that returns the larger of two whole numbers, promising the result is at least each of them, and print it for 3 and 7.
Write the text hello to a file named out.txt, then say it was written.
Fetch https://example.com/ and print how many characters came back, or why it could not be fetched.
Print how many of the numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are even.
Split a bill of 100.00 INR between 3 people so the parts add up exactly, and print each part.
Define a point with whole-number x and y, a function that adds two points, and print the x of 1,2 plus 3,4.
Say whether the environment variable HOME is set, without printing its value.
Write a pure function that says whether a whole number is positive, and print its answer for -3.
